# `pacvamp-repo snapshot promote`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp-repo snapshot promote <FLAGS>`

Move a channel pointer

## Flags
- **`--channel <CHANNEL>`** — rc or stable
- **`--id <ID>`** — Promote this snapshot; default the current rc when it soaked
- **`--soak <SOAK>`** — How long rc must have soaked before it becomes stable

  **Default:** `3d`
- **`--expedited`** — Mark the snapshot as an expedited security release
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
